heading: INT. MAGISTRATE COURTROOM, MARITIME DISTRICT - DAY

units.text: INT. MAGISTRATE COURTROOM, MARITIME DISTRICT - DAY
A paneled room that smells of old varnish and salt.
Brass lamps.
A wall of framed ship's charts.
Rain taps the high windows.
A single ceiling fan turns slowly.
JUDGE PERPETUA ADEBAYO-MARLOWE (60s, silver cropped hair, reading glasses pushed up on her head) sits on the bench, chin on her fist.
At the prosecution table stands PROSECUTOR LOUISA VANTONGEREN-HAYES (40s, tailored charcoal suit, clipped consonants).

At the defense table sits her opposite number, DEFENDER IMOGEN ASANTE-BRIGGS (30s, braids pinned up, scuffed court shoes), beside her client: CAPTAIN RUTH OKONJO-STRAND (50s, weathered, salt-white hair, hands folded).
In the gallery's first row, a young CLERK, DAVID MBEKI-LOWELL (20s, bow tie, notebook), sits with his pen frozen.
By the door, an old BAILIFF, ARCHIBALD NSEREKO-WELLS (60s, belt too tight), leans on his stick.
The fan ticks.
A phone, left on the bench by the judge, buzzes.
She ignores it.
It buzzes again.
She sighs, lifts it, and holds it to her ear without turning it on.
This is Perpetua.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Your Honor, the tribunal in Rotterdam has the transcript ready.
units.name: INTERPRETER

units.text: Thank you. Hold it. We will resume in a moment.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: She lowers the phone and sets it on the bench.
Louisa shuffles her papers; Imogen leans to Ruth and murmurs something.
Ruth does not respond; David scribbles; Archibald shifts his stick from one hand to the other.
A gull shrieks past the window.
Louisa straightens her jacket, takes a step forward from the table, and clasps her hands behind her.
Imogen stands, one palm on Ruth's shoulder.
Perpetua nods at Louisa.
Ms. Vantongeren-Hayes. Proceed.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Your Honor, the Crown submits that the Captain abandoned the vessel before the last of the crew was recovered.
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: Objection. Abandoned is a loaded term.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: Sustained. Rephrase.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: The Captain left the vessel.
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: She was ordered off.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: By whom?
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: By the Coast Guard.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: Who is not here to say so.
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: Because the Crown didn't call them.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: Louisa's lips whiten.
Perpetua leans forward.
Counsel, I'll hear argument, not squabbling.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Of course, Your Honor.
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: Of course.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: The two women, lawyer and lawyer, turn to the bench in perfect unison.
Ruth lets out the smallest breath.
Perpetua catches it, and holds her gaze.
Captain Okonjo-Strand. Do you wish to say anything?
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Ruth, sit down.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: I can't.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: She stands very straight.
The fan ticks.
The rain taps.
In the back of the gallery, Archibald lowers his stick to the floor.
David puts down his pen.
There was a boy on the foredeck. Seventeen. I told them he was aboard. They told me the water was rising and the tender had room for twelve. I counted twelve. I did not count him.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Perpetua closes her eyes.
Louisa does not move.
Imogen puts a hand over her mouth.
That is what I've come to say.
units.name: RUTH

units.text: Nobody speaks.
The fan makes four full turns.
Then Perpetua opens her eyes.
Mr. Mbeki-Lowell, please read that into the record.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
units.name: DAVID

units.text: The phone on the bench buzzes again.
Perpetua picks it up.
Rotterdam, we are ready.
units.name: JUDGE PERPETUA

units.text: Your Honor, one correction to the transcript. The Coast Guard has filed a statement this morning.
units.name: INTERPRETER

units.text: What statement?
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: It confirms the Captain's account. The boy was reported to them at 0412.
units.name: INTERPRETER

units.text: Louisa goes still.
She looks at Ruth.
At the bench.
At her own folder, which she closes carefully, as one closes a door in a house after a death.
Your Honor. The Crown withdraws.
units.name: LOUISA

units.text: The fan turns.
Rain.
A gull.
Ruth sits down, unsteadily, and Imogen's arm goes around her.
